layout_and_navigation.desktop: Left sticky sidebar (w-64) with active module indicator in glowing emerald green, sleek collapsible mode option, top header with CET live clock, motto banner, quick status indicators, and PIN lock trigger.
layout_and_navigation.mobile: Mobile-first responsive layout with bottom navigation bar (fixed bottom-0 z-50 h-16 bg-neutral-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-neutral-800) featuring key 5 shortcuts + 'More Modules' drawer.
layout_and_navigation.containers: Dense Bento Grid system (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6). Each card must have p-4 sm:p-5 padding, 1px subtle border (#262626 or white/10), hover glow effect, and custom rounded corners (rounded-xl).

modules_guidelines.name: Dashboard / Centrum
modules_guidelines.description: Central hub with live CET date/time clock, Polish header motto, 4 main KPI metric cards (Net Balance, Active Projects, Win Rate %, streak count), Trading alert widget, active project status pipeline, and quick module launcher matrix.

modules_guidelines.name: Daily Schedule / Plan Dnia
modules_guidelines.description: Chronological timeline showing Killzones (London 09:00-12:00 CET / NY 14:00-17:00 CET highlighted in Cyan/Green), 'Spacer z Leo' (dog walk with picture card), deep work blocks, PPL training session.

modules_guidelines.name: Tasks / Zadania (To-Do)
modules_guidelines.description: Priority filtered task manager (P1-Critical Neon Red, P2-Important Cyan, P3-Normal Emerald), tag filtering (Office, Project, Car, Personal), checkable items with strike-through animations.

modules_guidelines.name: Habit Tracker / Nawyki
modules_guidelines.description: Weekly habit grid (Mon-Sun) with streak counters, completion percentage progress bar, heatmaps for habit consistency (Cold shower, Deep reading, Clean diet, No sugar, Code/Trade practice).

modules_guidelines.name: Finance / Finanse
modules_guidelines.description: Income vs Expense tracking table with search/filter, quick transaction adder modal, total balance summary KPI, and interactive Expense category pie chart (Recharts/Chart.js).

modules_guidelines.name: Trading Journal / Dziennik Tradingowy
modules_guidelines.description: Detailed trades table (Symbol, Direction L/S, Entry, Exit, R:R, P&L PLN/USD, Outcome Win/Loss), 12-point A+ Execution Checklist modal/card, Position Size Calculator widget, TradingView read-only alert log feed, win-rate statistics.

modules_guidelines.name: Training PPL / Trening PPL
modules_guidelines.description: Weekly Push/Pull/Legs workout split matrix with target sets/reps, log completion toggles, and integrated interactive 15-min HIT Interval Timer with audio/visual flash alerts.

modules_guidelines.name: Nutrition / Dieta & Makro
modules_guidelines.description: Daily Meal Plan timeline (Breakfast, Lunch, Pre-Workout, Dinner), Macro summary progress bars (Protein, Carbs, Fats, Kcal counter), and checkable interactive Shopping List.

modules_guidelines.name: ERROR444 Music / Muzyka pipeline
modules_guidelines.description: Track pipeline Kanban/Table board across stages: Idea → Lyrics → Beat → Mix → Master → Done. Includes song details drawer, tempo/key info, audio player snippet preview player simulation.

modules_guidelines.name: Car Workshop / Warsztat Auto-Tech
modules_guidelines.description: Vehicle specs & maintenance history logbook, searchable OBD-II diagnostic error code solver, Diagnosta AI diagnostic prompt wizard, and pending repair tasks list.

modules_guidelines.name: Knowledge Base / Notatnik & Prompty
modules_guidelines.description: Searchable markdown note system with multi-tag filtering, AI prompt library cards, external bookmarks, code/command snippet copy buttons.

modules_guidelines.name: Reports / Raporty Wieczorne
modules_guidelines.description: Daily evening review form (Mood slider 1-10, Sleep hours, Energy, Stress triggers, Daily expenses sum), automated daily summary generator, and weekly performance review graphs.

modules_guidelines.name: Settings / Ustawienia & Backup
modules_guidelines.description: PIN code security lock management, JSON data export & import functionality, factory reset with confirmation modal, theme info, and local storage status summary.

component_guidelines.buttons: Use pill or sharp tactical buttons with border border-emerald-500/30 hover:bg-emerald-500/10 hover:border-emerald-400 active:scale-95 transition-all duration-200. Accent cyan buttons use border-cyan-500/30 hover:bg-cyan-500/10.
component_guidelines.cards: Card items must use bg-neutral-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl hover:border-neutral-700 transition-all shadow-lg p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col justify-between.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn/UI inputs with dark surface bg-neutral-950 border-neutral-800 focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500 text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-600.
component_guidelines.modals_and_dialogs: Dark backdrop blur (bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md) with crisp border border-neutral-800 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 shadow-2xl.
component_guidelines.toasts: Use Sonner toasts with custom dark theme, green indicator for success, cyan for info, red for error alerts.

motion_and_effects.framer_motion: Animate module page transitions with subtle opacity and scale (opacity 0 -> 1, y: 10 -> 0).
motion_and_effects.micro_interactions: Checkboxes trigger punchy scale bounce; timers pulsate cyan/green when active; killzones glow during live CET window.
motion_and_effects.ambient_glow: Use subtle radial gradient backdrops `bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-emerald-900/10 via-neutral-950 to-black`.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, module tabs, task items, habit checkboxes, timer triggers, lock screen keypads MUST have distinct data-testid in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='module-nav-trading', data-testid='hit-timer-start-button', data-testid='pin-input-field').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: All text must maintain APCA high contrast standards on dark background (#0a0a0a / #141414).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app defaults to dark mode with deep black (#0a0a0a) and rich dark charcoal (#141414) surfaces.
Incorporate BOTH accent colors specified by user: Green (#22c55e) as primary tactical accent, Cyan (#06b6d4) as secondary alert accent.
Prominently display the Polish header motto in the header / dashboard hero section: 'Nie jestem tym, który ucieka od rzeczywistości. Jestem tym, który TWORZY rzeczywistość.'
Build a robust PIN lock screen overlay or modal with 4-digit entry (e.g. default PIN 4444 or 1234) for command center authorization.
Implement all 13 modules with real state management in React (persisted via LocalStorage so user data stays intact).
Include export and import JSON features in Settings so the user can backup and restore their entire Second Brain database.
Use Lucide icons throughout and maintain high-density data visualization.
